# Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide agent guidance in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Before substantial work, read the shared project memory:

- [`docs/AI_CONTEXT.md`](../docs/AI_CONTEXT.md) for stable project facts and conventions.
- [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](../docs/DECISIONS.md) for recorded technical decisions and rationale.
- [`docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`](../docs/CURRENT_STATE.md) for current work, known issues, and next steps.

Keep these files current as required by `AGENTS.md`. Treat source and repository configuration as authoritative, distinguish verified facts from unknowns, preserve uncommitted user changes, and never record secrets or sensitive values.
